title: Davante Adams' touchdown gives Rams a 7-6 lead

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Davante Adams' touchdown gives Rams a 7-6 lead
sources.description: The last time the Rams played on Monday Night Football — in Week 2 against the Giants — Davante Adams caught eight passes for 195 yards and two touchdowns.
